scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.prod:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production up -d --build
